result.topic_en: Gauss works on cubic residues: he expresses the cubic Gaussian period product qq in terms of cyclotomic numbers (00), (01), …, considers power sums modulo p, and sets up relations among the classes of x and x+1 as cubic residues.

methods.what: Square of a cubic Gaussian period written as a character-type sum over indices
Euler's criterion for cubic residuosity: the (n-1)/3 power of zz-z gives a cube root of unity, which classifies the terms
Power sum modulo p evaluated as a geometric series in a primitive root g
Congruences for the cyclotomic numbers (ij) of order 3, weighted by a cube root of unity γ
Symmetries of the cyclotomic numbers of order 3: 00+1=12=21=a, 22=10=01=b, 11=20=02=c
Products of the periods expressed linearly through the cyclotomic numbers
Classifying x and x+1 by cubic residue class, using substitutions such as 1/x
